purpose: Audit deployable clean-only appearance/evidence scores on the immutable Epic native-weather feature shard after temporal_viewpos_z failed.

candidates.feature_rms_viewpos_abs_z: Absolute robust deviation of current patch feature RMS from clean view/position statistics.
candidates.spatial_neighbor_viewpos_abs_z: Absolute robust deviation of current patch-to-neighbour cosine residual from clean view/position statistics.
candidates.appearance_prototype_viewpos_z: Positive robust deviation of current patch cosine distance to the clean mean normalized feature at the same view/position.
candidates.appearance_diagonal_viewpos_z: Positive robust deviation of per-patch RMS diagonal standardized feature distance from clean view/position/channel statistics.

checks: fog_heavy score mean > fog_light score mean
score versus paired-clean patch-delta Spearman >= 0.10 at both fog levels
score AUROC for the top 20 percent paired-delta patches >= 0.60 at both fog levels
paired-clean delta mean is positive and fog_heavy > fog_light
fog_heavy > fog_light > clear score mean independently on both routes

decision.no_candidate_passes: Keep temporal as a transient component only and design/train a clean self-supervised appearance predictor before any adapter training.
decision.candidate_passes: The candidate is eligible as an appearance component in a separately preregistered multi-source adapter target; no training starts automatically.
